extracted.intended_audience: Iowa state agency rulewriters, agency staff, attorneys, and members of the public interested in Iowa administrative rules and the rulemaking/notice-and-comment process
extracted.subtask_description: Portal-level guidance and links for locating, commenting on, and understanding Iowa Administrative Rules (IAC), the Iowa Administrative Bulletin (IAB), emergency rules, procedural uniform rules, and related archival/search tools. Useful for agency rulewriters, stakeholders preparing comments, and legal/administrative research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of administrative rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative rules implement or interpret law; prescribe policy; or describe the organization, procedure, or practice requirements of an executive branch agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes what administrative rules are intended to do; sets the functional scope agencies should address when drafting rules (implementation/interpretation of statute, policy prescription, organizational/procedural/practice requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Iowa Administrative Code (IAC) — formats and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Iowa Administrative Code (IAC) (Current & Archive) - Composite of all adopted administrative rules organized by publication date and agency (Official - PDF format and Unofficial - PDF and RTF formats).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates where adopted rules are compiled, how they are organized (by publication date and agency), and distinguishes official (PDF) versus unofficial (PDF/RTF) formats for access and citation purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Iowa Administrative Bulletin (IAB) and IAC Supplement — publication cadence and content
rubrics_metrics.description: Iowa Administrative Bulletin (IAB) and IAC Supplement (Current & Archive) - Biweekly publication of all proposed and adopted changes to administrative rules and biweekly compilation of replacement IAC chapters (Official Version - PDF format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that the IAB is published biweekly and contains both proposed and adopted rule changes as well as replacement IAC chapters; useful for tracking active rulemaking and timing of proposal/adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment — on proposed administrative rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Current IAB Comment - On proposed administrative rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the IAB as the place to find proposed rules and the associated public comment opportunities; implies that stakeholders should consult the Current IAB to submit comments on proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emergency Rulemaking Documents — conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Emergency Rulemaking Documents - Rules filed without public notice and participation and with an early effective date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines emergency rules as those filed without the normal public notice/participation and that take effect quickly; signals different procedural/participation expectations for emergency rulemakings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uniform Rules on Agency Procedure — covered procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Uniform Rules on Agency Procedure - Agency procedures include petitions for rulemaking, declaratory orders, agency procedure for rulemaking, fair information practices, and contested cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists the categories of agency procedures governed by the Uniform Rules; indicates procedural avenues (e.g., petitions for rulemaking, declaratory orders) that parties and agencies should follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: IAC Index — topical navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: IAC Index - Index of general subject matters and concepts within the IAC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the IAC Index to locate rules by subject matter or concept; helpful for identifying where in the Code particular issues are addressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search Waivers of Administrative Rules — what can be searched
rubrics_metrics.description: Search Waivers of Administrative Rules - Search recorded waivers by agency, by time frame, by keyword or phrase, or by rule number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tool for finding instances where an agency has recorded a waiver of a rule; searchable across multiple facets (agency, time frame, keywords, rule number) which informs compliance and historical practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Iowa Departmental Rules (IDR) — archival rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Iowa Departmental Rules (IDR) - Rules that preceded the current IAC (1952-1975).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies archival source for rules in effect prior to the current IAC; relevant for historical research or legacy rule references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request Certified Copy of Iowa Administrative Code — certification authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Request Certified Copy of Iowa Administrative Code - Iowa Code §2B.18 authorizes the Iowa Administrative Code Editor to certify IAC provisions, for admission in a court of law or governmental office outside Iowa, by attesting to and authenticating such provisions appeared in the IAC as of a certain date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains statutory basis and procedure to request a certified copy of IAC provisions for legal or official use outside Iowa; relevant when authenticated proof of rule text/date is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse By Category — topical organization of rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Browse By Category (examples listed: Agriculture; Appropriations; Business and Commerce; Civil Law; Criminal Law; Education; Environmental Protection; Health; Infrastructure; Labor and Employment; Local Government; Natural Resources; Property; Records and Publications; Safety; Taxation; Transportation; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a subject-based taxonomy for locating rules by policy area; the long list of categories helps users find rules relevant to specific domains or stakeholder interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search and tracking tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Quick Search; Rulemaking Document Quick Search; Agency, Chapter, or Rule By Publication & Effective Dates; Rules Tracker; Search Legislative Documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates available search and tracking utilities for finding rule texts, rulemaking documents, publication/effective date histories, and for monitoring ongoing rule activity; useful for parties preparing comments or tracking regulatory changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and access distinctions (official vs unofficial; current vs archive)
rubrics_metrics.description: References throughout the page distinguish Current & Archive material and Official (PDF) versus Unofficial (PDF and RTF) versions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must note whether a version is official or unofficial and whether they are consulting current or archived materials when citing, commenting, or relying on rule text or rulemaking history.
